spans.s:
Evāvada is regarded by Ludwig in a very obscure passage of the Rigveda as the name of a singer beside kṣatra, manasa, and yajata. The commentator Sāyaṇa also interprets the word as a proper name. Roth, however, considers it to be an adjective meaning ‘truthful.’
Foot notes Translation of the Rigveda, 3, 138.
v. 44, 10.
